q: It is expected that students will state that chlorophyll traps light energy and converts it into ____ energy for the formation of carbohydrates.
e: It is expected that students will state that chlorophyll traps light energy and converts it into chemical energy for the formation of carbohydrates. Chemical is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Determine the types of nutrients, including macronutrients and ____ nutrients, which are important for living things and why they are important.
e: Determine the types of nutrients, including macronutrients and micronutrients nutrients, which are important for living things and why they are important. Micronutrients are vitamins and minerals needed in small amounts.

q: Explain the importance of a healthy diet and maintaining a healthy digestive system.
e: Diet is the missing word. Diet is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Identify and describe the structures and mechanisms involved in the digestive system of humans, including the formations of the teeth.
e: Teeth is the missing word. Teeth is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Understand the diseases that cause malfunction of the digestive system.
e: Diseases is the missing word. Diseases is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Nutrition is the process of taking food by an organism and utilizing it for ____ and growth.
e: Nutrition is the process of taking food by an organism and utilizing it for energy and growth. Energy is the idea that completes this fact.

q: The two types of nutrition are autotrophic and ____ nutrition.
e: The two types of nutrition are autotrophic and heterotrophic nutrition. Heterotrophs must take in food made by other organisms.

q: Autotrophic nutrition is the process by which organisms synthesize their own food using ____ energy.
e: Autotrophic nutrition is the process by which organisms synthesize their own food using solar energy. Solar is the idea that completes this fact.

q: The digestive system of humans includes the mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intestine, and ____.
e: The digestive system of humans includes the mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, large intestine, and anus. Anus is the idea that completes this fact.

q: The primary function of the small intestine is the absorption of nutrients into the ____ system.
e: The primary function of the small intestine is the absorption of nutrients into the circulatory system. Circulatory is the idea that completes this fact.
